entry.description: After an open of the log file timed out on the lock, each retrying event waits once instead of four times and no longer leaks a file stream. An open retried after a failure appends instead of truncating, whatever the locking model, also with `AppendToFile=false`, so what another process wrote meanwhile stays. `FileAppender.OpenFile` no longer sets `AppendToFile` (ANT-2026-D1OOS5L6, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
